feeds.title: Canberra Organic Growers Society Blog
feeds.description: The Canberra Organic Growers Society Inc (COGS) is a non-profit organization started in 1977 with the aim of providing a forum for organic growers to exchange information and encourage the adoption of organic growing methods. Discover planting guides, community gardens, Crop notes, and miscellaneous information on gardening in the COGS blog.

feeds.title: CityNews Canberra » Gardening
feeds.description: Check out insightful Gardening and maintenance tips in the Lifestyle and Gardening section of CityNews Canberra. CityNews is a family-owned news media business, offering trusted and independent local news to our loyal readers, who access CityNews content where and when it suits them, for free.

feeds.title: The Climate Factory Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about micro-forests and natural gardens in Canberra and how they can be preserved to provide more green lungs for the city. The Climate Factory is an environmental initiative by Edwina Robinson that focuses on creating tiny forest spaces in Urban areas. Her goal is to empower local leaders to build a climate-cooling micro-forest in every urban hotspot in Australia.

feeds.title: Gardening Girls Canberra Blog
feeds.description: Check out our Latest Articles on Pruning, Plant selection, and making your garden beautiful. Gardening Girls is a professional gardening service by experienced women gardeners in Australia servicing the Canberra region. We have an extensive body of knowledge and care for many styles of gardens, from formal and cottage styles to native gardens and roses.

feeds.title: ACT Gardening Solutions Blog
feeds.description: ACT Gardening Solutions brings a wealth of residential and corporate gardening experience from our team to our community in this residential gardening, lawn care, and landscaping blog. ACT Gardening Solutions is a Canberra-owned and operated business servicing lots of well-kept properties every month with an ever-growing team.

feeds.title: Canberra Weekly » Gardening
feeds.description: Find all your gardening tips and tricks all year round from our local horticulturist Tracey Bool. Read on to know more about Gardening techniques, environmental issues, and ways to keep your green spaces flourishing. Canberra Weekly is a community-focused lifestyle magazine covering a wide range of subjects and providing regular and diverse content.

feeds.title: Gardengigs Blog
feeds.description: In the Gardengigs blog, get to know things that inspire us from around the world, from garden shows to great gardens we've seen around Canberra. Gardengigs is a garden service company that offers complete solutions suiting to demands of each project. From consultation to custom design and construction, our work is tailored to your unique lifestyle and property.
